name: 100% 堆叠组分柱状图 (Stacked Composition Bar)
when: 100% (or fixed-total) stacked bar chart comparing component proportions (e.g. acid site S1-S4 distributions or Cu speciation percentages) across catalysts with vertical gradient bar fills, centered bold percentage labels, top horizontal gradient legend, and rotated x-axis sample labels.

required_slots.group: Sample category label column (e.g. Support, Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C).
required_slots.components: 2..6 numeric percentage columns (e.g. S1, S2, S3, S4) summing to ~100% per sample.

optional_slots.labels: Display names for component legend (e.g. S1, S2, S3, S4).
optional_slots.tick_rotation: Rotation angle for sample names on x-axis (20 deg in Fig4B).

constraints: Use fixed component palette (fill:0..3 = #B3CDE4, #CCEAC4, #FBB4AE, #DECAE5) matching the paired deconvolution panel (Fig4A) — colors follow component species, NOT sample identity.
Do NOT silently re-normalize integer-rounded percentages unless noted (e.g. Support 40+20+28+11 = 99% in acid_site_comp.xlsx — check whether y_lim=[0, 100] or normalized).
Render vertical gradient fill inside each stacked bar AND matching gradient patches in the top horizontal legend.

notes: Fig4B: 4 samples (Support, Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C) with 20-deg rotated bold x-tick labels.
Centered bold integer percentage labels inside each bar segment.
Top horizontal 4-column legend with gradient patches matching bar fills.
Excel file acid_site_comp.xlsx has Origin subscript escapes (Cu\-(1.26)-MAZ) and header at row 1 (S1..S4).
